verdict.rationale: Requesty issues its own gateway API keys: clients authenticate with a Requesty token rather than a provider key (docs-26), and service accounts create non-human keys whose spend isn't tied to a user (docs-19). Each key or service account can carry its own monthly spend cap (docs-18), and BYOK lets provider keys sit behind the gateway (docs-8). Missing for 10: explicit team-level key scoping or minting docs, an explicit statement that provider keys are never exposed to key holders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
